cwd.name: isolates cd in the first stage from later commands
cwd.command: cd /work | cat; pwd; echo "$PWD"; cat input/data.txt

cwd.name: isolates cd from the next pipeline stage
isolates cd in the last stage by default
keeps a brace group's cd inside its pipeline stage
restores cwd when a pipeline stage exits with an error
cwd.command: { cd /work; exit 7; } | cat; status=$?; pwd; echo "$PWD"; echo "$status"

cwd.name: preserves the last stage's cd when lastpipe is explicitly enabled
cwd.command: shopt -s lastpipe; echo data | cd /work; pwd; echo "$PWD"; cat data.txt

cwd.name: still isolates earlier stages when lastpipe is enabled
cwd.command: shopt -s lastpipe; cd /work | pwd; pwd; echo "$PWD"
